description: Grey long-necked bird moves leftward into the frame from the right edge, neck and head lowering across the tiles; it is already partly visible at f28.
Hunter stick arms absent at f28, a left arm line appears at f29 and both by f30 (arm pose swap or swing; mechanism unclear).
Mammoth lurches/steps leftward and lowers; its spears stay lodged in its back.
Right-hand hunter raises a spear (f199-f200) and the spear is then in flight leftward and upward (f201-f203).
Handwritten label above first-tick arrow goes from a small scribble (f297) to the legible quoted label (f298).
Bear silhouette absent at f299 and present at f300 at the last tick, with no intermediate frame (pop-in).
Lecturer pointer rotates from a low near-horizontal angle (f380-f383) to an upward diagonal (f384-f387); a green leaf shape shows at lower right by f387.
Whole timeline translates rightward across the frame, bear silhouette cropped off the right edge from f467-f469; motion appears to decelerate (INFERRED from tile positions).
Tick spacing grows slightly (about 87 to 91 px in tile space) indicating a slight zoom-in during the pan.
Small "5" glyph shows partial at f466 and complete from f467.
Frame-to-frame brightness flicker (lamp glow and wall tone vary) with soft blur; door and green light jitter a few pixels; no new objects (camera shake or flicker effect not identified).
Strong radial/zoom blur streaks around the machine door with brightness flicker (darker at f818); door stays near the same screen position.
Room and lecturer look unchanged at tile resolution; detector peak value is low (1.43).
Room and lecturer look unchanged at tile resolution; detector peak value is low (1.63).
Lecturer figure enters from the right edge and drifts slightly leftward, still cropped by the edge in all eight tiles; room static.
Lecturer fully in frame, stick arms swing outward/gesture and body drifts slightly; pod and room static.
Pull-back: giant sloth goes from partial claws at top right to nearly full body with tail by f1391 while the modern sloth shrinks and moves toward lower left.
"modern sloth" arrow label and "2 feet" bracket shrink and fade from legible (f1384) to near invisible (f1389).

Scene content shifts rightward and down: chalk text, sign and lectern move right, projector enters from the left at f1582, leaf skirt becomes visible from f1584 (pull-back and pan; INFERRED combination).
Red "VS" arrives as a huge crop filling the frame at f1686, overlaps the lecturer at f1687, then scales down through f1688-f1689 to its final size at f1690 (slam-in).
Black jagged crack line appears between V and S at f1690, absent in f1688-f1689.
Lecturer figure idles with small arm and head shifts; background trees static.
Trees and lecturer shift leftward across the tiles, so the scene scrolls leftward (pan or object plus camera move cannot be separated).
Giant sloth, already cropped at the right edge at f1766, advances into frame and a bush appears at bottom right by f1771.
Chalkboard picture inset collapses vertically to a thin line at f2073, a thin distorted band at f2074, and is nearly gone at f2075.
New black-and-white inset picture appears at its full size from f2076 and stays; lecturer mouth changes shape.
